summary: Repaired the three defects planted by task_116 that failed e2e_live: the summary counted d.length+1 notes, the Clear all handler was empty (now sends DELETE /api/notes, reloads, and also works with Enter and Space), and the hint used the card background colour (now var(--muted)). Added three page tests that failed on the old page; the 14 e2e tests pass locally against the fixed app.
